title: SKILL.md frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of every SKILL.md in the repository.

name.description: Kebab-case skill name; must match the containing directory.

category.description: Taxonomy category; must exist in catalog.yaml.

description.description: Multi-sentence description. Should include 'Use when' and 'Don't use when' guidance for the agent.

allowed-tools.description: CLI tools / runtimes the skill is allowed to invoke.
